title: Page Postmaclone Anonymize Selects So Large MySQL Tables Do Not OOM
description: Pages live anonymize SELECTs by primary key so buffered PDO MySQL does not load multi-million-row tables into PHP during factory produce.

test_plan.description: Anonymize SELECTs are paged by primary key
steps: In the ngramx app container run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Postmaclone/LiveAnonymizerTest.php --no-coverage
After release, dispatch Postmaclone produce (Hydra) and confirm bank_transactions anonymize reaches 100% without the runner process being Killed
